terminal_judgment.protocol_abort: Any source, code, dataset, invariant, count, resource, endpoint, evaluator, or evidence-bundle mismatch; this is no method judgment and forbids repair or rerun in place.
terminal_judgment.pass: All protocol gates PASS; opponent-mix post-calibration relative MSE reduction point >=0.10 with CI95 lower >0; self-play MSE increase point <=0.10 with CI95 upper <=0.15; both 5M windows and both complete quick5k bundles valid; treatment-control quick5k delta >=10 bb/100 with paired CI95 lower >=-20 bb/100.
terminal_judgment.fail: A complete valid fixed window where opponent-mix relative MSE reduction point <=0, or self-play MSE increase point >0.15, or treatment-control quick5k delta <=-10 bb/100, or a treatment-only selector/aggression hard validity failure occurs while control remains valid.
terminal_judgment.inconclusive: A complete valid fixed window that is neither PASS nor FAIL.
terminal_judgment.pass_next: separate registered stronger external screen only; no automatic 100k
terminal_judgment.fail_or_inconclusive_next: freeze CT002 and return to a separately registered four-family route review; do not automatically launch another behavior window
